definitions.availability: Simulated ob_time + lag, not actual release/receipt timestamp; archive QC version1 is revised.
definitions.calendar_denominator: All UTC hourly issues 2016-2022 minus initial29/final4h; no label eligibility examined.
definitions.support: Center r=T_adv-age in [h-1,h], at least one active token; also report soft null mass distribution.
definitions.threshold: 20% applies only descriptively to center support; no soft-mass cutoff or label cohort is approved.
definitions.direction: Own observation-time wind-from; missing direction uses same-time circular regional mean if defined.
definitions.speed: Mean of same-time upwind station speeds; regional mean if no upwind speeds; kappa*max(v,2).
definitions.calm: Own speed <2m/s supplies no physical prior. Direction fallback is audit-only input rule, not deployed.
definitions.quality: Report raw nonmissing coverage and QC codes; do not label all qcv1 values QC-passed or change frozen masks.
definitions.soft_prior: Normal CDF integral, sigma=max(1,0.5*T_adv), cos(direction difference)*exp(-0.5*(crosswind/30)^2).
definitions.reference_M: Content scores zero, q summed/number wind tokens then qmean/(1+qmean); not trained attention.
definitions.window: Two interpretations of 24h reported; neither chosen using outcomes.
definitions.remaining_histogram: Half-open bins except final bin; [0,4] fraction computed directly, includes endpoints.

unresolved_for_claude: Soft effective-support threshold and label-eligible denominator
24h window anchoring; kappa speed-floor order; invalid-direction fallback policy
Full-text literature review is recorded separately; no automatic novelty or feasibility pass
